entries.title: Castation (Dreamcast)
entries.description:
Castation v0.4.0 — Dreamcast emulator (Flycast).

MANUAL INSTALL — HOMEBREW LAUNCHER:
1. Castation/ → /data/homebrew/Castation/
2. Check Castation/eboot.elf and homebrew.js exist.
3. Open Homebrew Launcher → Castation (NOT a PS5 title).

BEFORE YOU PLAY
• Games → /data/homebrew/Castation/games/
• BIOS optional → Castation/bios/; use HLE BIOS otherwise.

IF IT WON'T START
• Check eboot.elf placement and that Homebrew Launcher is running.
• If PS5 Library opens another title, launch Castation manually.

entries.title: Snes9x PS5 (Super Nintendo)
entries.description:
Snes9x PS5 v2.6 — Super Nintendo (SNES) emulator.

INSTALL
1. Recommended: send Snes9xPS5-v2.6.elf to payload loader.
2. ELF installs PPSA99922/ into /data/homebrew/ AND stays helper.
3. Or manually extract ZIP to /data/homebrew/PPSA99922/.

BEFORE YOU PLAY
• Run kstuff + ShadowMountPlus + matching Snes9x helper.
• ELF loader port 9021; ROMs → /data/snes9x/roms/.
• Standard SNES needs no BIOS; special BIOS → /data/snes9x/bios/.
• L3 + R3 opens the in-game pause menu.

IF IT WON'T START
• No /data access? Send v2.6 Snes9x ELF again.
• Check PPSA99922/eboot.bin, folder and title registration.
• Logs → /data/snes9x/logs/.
• Old Snes9x (PPSA99009) conflicts with ProsperoLichess!

entries.title: Porpoise (GameCube / Wii)
entries.description:
Porpoise v3.0 — GameCube + Wii emulator (Dolphin).

INSTALL
1. PPSA99764/ → /data/homebrew/PPSA99764/
2. Register with ShadowMountPlus 1.7beta4+.

BEFORE YOU PLAY
• Games → /data/porpoise/games/ or USB.
• Load kstuff + supported jailbreak (etaHEN, etc.).
• Keep saves in /data/porpoise/ when updating.

IF IT WON'T START
• Check ShadowMount+ version, folder and eboot.bin.
• Can't access /data? Check etaHEN Legacy Command Server.
• Use FTP binary transfers when copying files.
